sections.p: A day goes on record when you open that day's line, in the app, from a widget or from a reminder. One a day. A day runs from 4:00 AM to 3:59 AM, so late nights count.
Missed days don't erase the ones on record.
It's between you and you. Saying Not today keeps the day on record.

list: Day 7: every UNSETLD drop opens to you 24 hours before the public.
Day 30: 10% off one order each collection.
Day 90: a woven patch with your number, free with your next order.
Day 180: the member price goes to 15%.
Day 365: the 365 piece, made only for people who reach a year. It's sold at full price and never restocked.

sections.p: If 14 days pass with nothing on record, early access and member prices pause until you put 7 more days on record. Your count and milestones stay.
One member-price order per collection. Up to $25 off an order. Doesn't combine with other codes, including the 10% first-order code. Excludes the 365 piece. One patch per person.
Full Edition doesn't change any of this. Access is the same for everyone.
To use access you need a free account, made with Sign in with Apple, so we can hold your place.
For US residents 18 and over.

Access is earned with days on record in the app. It can't be bought, and Full Edition doesn't change it. Early access opens drops 24 hours before the public. The member price is 10% off one order each collection, 15% from Day 180, up to $25 off an order. The patch is one per person and ships free with an order. The 365 piece is sold at full price.
No cash value. Not transferable. Codes are single use and don't combine with other codes, including the first-order code. The member price excludes the 365 piece.
If 14 days pass with nothing on record, early access and member prices pause until 7 more days are on record. Your count and milestones stay.
We may change or end the program with 30 days' notice in the app.

UNSETLD gives you a daily line, reminders, a night check and a record of the days you showed up. It is motivation, not medical, financial or professional advice.

Full Edition is sold through Apple as an auto-renewing subscription (yearly or monthly) or a one-time lifetime purchase. Payment is charged to your Apple ID at confirmation of purchase, or when a free trial ends. Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel in Settings, your name, Subscriptions. Any unused part of a free trial ends when you buy a subscription.
Apple's Licensed Application End User License Agreement (apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula) also applies.
Access to the clothing brand is covered by the Access terms in Settings.
The lines in the app are original to UNSETLD, except attributed quotes, which are public-domain translations. Lines you write yourself stay on your phone.
unsetldclothing@gmail.com
Your record, your standard, saved lines and your lines live on your iPhone. There are no ads, no tracking and no analytics SDKs.

Purchases: Apple processes payments, and RevenueCat (our subscription provider) receives an anonymous app user ID and your purchase history so Full Edition works across your devices. Time check: the app asks unsetld.com for the current date so days on record stay honest. No identifier is sent. Config: the app reads a small public file from unsetld.com to know whether access is on and when drops open.

sections.h: If you sign in for access
sections.p: Signing in with Apple is optional and only needed to use access. We receive an Apple user ID and, if you choose, a private relay email. We store the days you put on record so we can hold your place and issue single-use codes. Nothing else.
Reminders and the night check are local notifications scheduled on your phone. Drop alerts are separate, off by default, and only on if you turn them on.
Links to unsetld.com open in Safari, which is covered by that site's privacy policy.
Delete the app to remove what's stored on your phone. To delete an access account, email unsetldclothing@gmail.com from the address on the account or sign out and ask us to remove it.
unsetldclothing@gmail.com
